items.title: Separate model, simulator and evidence
items.subject: simulation
items.description: Use exact controls and a predeclared statistical procedure without seed-shopping or model overclaims.
items.use_when: A target generates trajectories or stochastic estimates under a stated model.
items.do_not_use_when: Simulation output is being used to establish the real-world model's validity without external evidence.

items.title: A two-state simulator with an exact reference
items.subject: simulation
items.description: Check deterministic transition boundaries and a two-step probability of 5/16.
items.use_when: Designing a small inspectable simulation acceptance case.
items.do_not_use_when: Treating one statistical pass, one seed, or stationary probabilities as proof of transient behavior.
